name: How much value does heated flooring add to a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Is radiant or heated bathroom flooring worth the added cost in Southern California?
mainEntity.text: Is radiant or heated bathroom flooring worth the added cost in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: Heated flooring is one of those upgrades that improves daily comfort more than it improves core functionality. In a luxury primary bathroom, it can create a high-end feel that many homeowners enjoy. In a smaller or more budget-conscious remodel, the added cost may be better spent on waterproofing, lighting, storage, or a better shower system. The installation also needs to be planned early because the floor build-up, electrical connections, and tile schedule must all work together. Homeowners should ask whether the system is compatible with their chosen flooring and how it will affect the total project cost. It makes the most sense when the bathroom is already being fully rebuilt and the budget has room for comfort features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Heated flooring is a comfort upgrade rather than a necessity. It can make a bathroom feel more luxurious, but it usually adds cost and complexity without being the main driver of resale value. It is most worthwhile in primary bathrooms and high-end remodels.
